modules.title: Introduction to Creation and the Fall
modules.html:
Genesis 1-3: God creates heaven and earth in six days and rests on the seventh; man is made in God's image; Adam and Eve in Eden; the Fall through disobedience and its consequences for humanity. This section covers introduction to creation and the fall.

Key points

  • According to the Genesis account of creation, God created the firmament on the _____ day. — second.
  • God's sovereignty is best demonstrated in the creation story by His ability to _____. — create by spoken word.
  • According to the first account of creation, God created the firmament on the _____ day. — second.
  • The creation of man in the second account of creation was primarily from _____. — the dust of the ground.
  • Creation took: — 6 days.

Worked examples

Q: According to the Genesis account of creation, God created the firmament on the _____ day.
A: second — On the second day, God created the expanse (firmament) to separate the waters from the waters (Genesis 1:6-8).

Q: God's sovereignty is best demonstrated in the creation story by His ability to _____.
A: create by spoken word — God's sovereignty is shown through 'Ex Nihilo' creation—bringing things into existence simply by commanding them to be.

quiz.q: According to the Genesis account of creation, God created the firmament on the _____ day.
quiz.solution: On the second day, God created the expanse (firmament) to separate the waters from the waters (Genesis 1:6-8).

quiz.q: God's sovereignty is best demonstrated in the creation story by His ability to _____.
quiz.solution: God's sovereignty is shown through 'Ex Nihilo' creation—bringing things into existence simply by commanding them to be.

quiz.q: According to the first account of creation, God created the firmament on the _____ day.
quiz.solution: In Genesis 1:6-8, God created the firmament (the expanse) on the second day to separate the waters from the waters.

quiz.q: The creation of man in the second account of creation was primarily from _____.
quiz.solution: Genesis 2:7 states that the Lord God formed man of dust from the ground and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life.

quiz.q: Creation took:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: 6 days.

quiz.q: On the first day of creation, God created:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Light.

quiz.q: Creation of man day:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: 6.

quiz.q: Creation duration:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: 6 days.

quiz.q: "For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God" is in?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Romans.

quiz.q: According to Paul in Galatians, the fruit of the Spirit includes the following EXCEPT _____.
quiz.solution: Wisdom is listed as a 'gift' of the Spirit in 1 Corinthians 12, while the others are listed as 'fruit' in Galatians 5.

quiz.q: Elijah was taken up to heaven in a _____.
quiz.solution: 2 Kings 2:11 records that a chariot and horses of fire appeared, and Elijah went up in a whirlwind.

quiz.q: Samson's strength was in his _____.
quiz.solution: As a Nazirite, Samson's strength was tied to his vow, symbolized by his uncut hair.

quiz.q: Paul wrote the letter to the Romans to explain the doctrine of _____.
quiz.solution: Romans is Paul's most theological letter, focusing on how humans are made right with God through faith in Christ.

quiz.q: The division of the kingdom of Israel took place during the reign of _____.
quiz.solution: Rehoboam's refusal to lighten the labor yoke imposed by his father Solomon led to the rebellion of the ten northern tribes.

quiz.q: The Transfiguration of Jesus took place in the presence of _____.
quiz.solution: Jesus took the inner circle of Peter, James, and John up into a high mountain where He was transfigured before them.

quiz.q: The Jewish high priest who presided over the trial of Jesus was _____.
quiz.solution: Caiaphas was the high priest that year who organized the plot to kill Jesus.

quiz.q: The Jerusalem Council (Acts 15) met primarily to discuss _____.
quiz.solution: The council determined that Gentile believers did not need to be circumcised or follow the whole Mosaic Law to be saved.

quiz.q: Ananias and Sapphira died because they _____.
options: lied to the Holy Spirit about the proceeds of a sale
quiz.solution: They kept back part of the money from a land sale while pretending to give the full amount to the church (Acts 5).

quiz.q: First miracle:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Water to wine.

quiz.q: Peter healed lame man at:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Beautiful Gate.

quiz.q: Samson's strength in:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Hair.

quiz.q: Josiah found:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Book of Law.

quiz.q: The Israelites ate Manna in the:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Wilderness.

quiz.q: The beatitudes were given during the:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Sermon on the Mount.

quiz.q: Job was known for his:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Patience/Endurance.

quiz.q: Jesus was born in:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Bethlehem.

quiz.q: Zacchaeus was a:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Tax collector.

quiz.q: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego were delivered from:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Fire.

quiz.q: Who succeeded Moses as the leader of Israel?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Joshua.

quiz.q: Peter's vision at Joppa taught him that...
options: God shows no partiality; Gentiles are welcome
The end of the world was near
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: God shows no partiality; Gentiles are welcome.

quiz.q: God created light on the:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: First day.

quiz.q: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego were thrown into:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Fiery furnace.

quiz.q: The parable of the Sower explains:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Reception of God's word.

quiz.q: Lazarus was dead for:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: 4 days.

quiz.q: Paul and Barnabas separated over:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: John Mark.

quiz.q: Ezra was a:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Scribe/Priest.

quiz.q: Paul shipwreck:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Malta.

quiz.q: Good Samaritan taught:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Neighborliness.

quiz.q: The serpent deceived Eve by telling her she would?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Be like God.

quiz.q: The first plague God brought upon Egypt was?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Water to blood.

quiz.q: The Israelites were defeated at Ai because of?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Achan’s sin.

quiz.q: The kingdom of Israel split during the reign of?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Rehoboam.

quiz.q: Nehemiah returned to Jerusalem to?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Rebuild the walls.

quiz.q: The "Day of the Lord" is a theme in?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Joel.

quiz.q: Who survived the lions' den?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Daniel.

quiz.q: The "Wise Men" (Magi) followed a?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Star.

quiz.q: During the Transfiguration, Jesus talked with?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Moses and Elijah.

quiz.q: The sign on the cross (INRI) meant?
options: Jesus of Nazareth, King of the Jews
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Jesus of Nazareth, King of the Jews.

quiz.q: Which Gospel is the shortest?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Mark.

quiz.q: Ananias was sent by God to?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Restore Saul’s sight.
